description: Animated sheep resource props for the Tiny Swords asset pack. Three behaviour states (idle, move, grass) exported from Sheep.aseprite as horizontal sprite strips.

props.order: After ground tiles, cliff bases, and stair ramps; before top overlays (clouds, etc.).
props.note: Sheep share the y-sorted props layer with trees, bushes, and rocks.

move.note: Walking loop; not used in static example scatter.

grass.note: Grazing loop; used in example scatter.

behaviorRules.implementedIn: elevation-examples.html (reference implementation; not loaded from this file at runtime)
behaviorRules.note: Constants below are illustrative defaults from the example. Other projects may tune them.

idleOrGrass.onEnter: Pick a new random heading (0 to 2π radians).

animationBinding.note: On state change, swap the active sprite definition and randomize animation phase.

roaming.rule: Only the move state translates position. Each frame, advance along the current heading by speed * deltaTime. A step is committed only when walkability and elevation rules pass and the new position stays within wanderRadiusTiles of the spawn (home) point.

blockedSteering.rule: When a step is rejected (blocked tile, elevation violation, or beyond wander radius), re-aim toward home using atan2(homeY - fy, homeX - fx) plus random jitter in [-0.8, +0.8] radians.

elevationCrossing.rule: Sheep may change elevation only by stepping between two ramp cells one tier apart. Both the current tile (floor of fx/fy) and the target tile (floor of next position) must be ramp cells, and the absolute elevation delta must be exactly 1.
elevationCrossing.rampIdentification: A cell is a ramp when cellRecord[y][x].layer starts with "ramp" (e.g. ramp-top, ramp-bottom, ramp-backdrop).
elevationCrossing.sameTierMoves: When elevations match, no ramp is required.
elevationCrossing.forbidden: Stepping directly across a cliff edge onto a different tier without traversing ramp cells.

spriteClearance.rule: Reject a candidate position if the 128x128 sprite bounding box (anchored bottom-centre on the float position) overlaps any land cell (elevation >= 1) whose elevation differs from the sheep's base tile.
spriteClearance.rampExemption: When the base tile is a ramp cell, sprite clearance is skipped for that position because ramps intentionally bridge tiers.
spriteClearance.rationale: The sprite is larger than its 1-tile logical footprint. A base point that is legally on one tier can still visually spill into neighbouring tiers without this check.

walkability.rule: A candidate float position (fx, fy) is walkable when all of the following hold:
requirements: Base tile (floor(fx), floor(fy)) is in bounds and land (elevation >= 1).
Base tile is not in blockedCells (trees, bushes, rocks occupy their spawn tile).
cellRecord layer is not "cliff" (vertical cliff-face cells are not standable).
spriteClearance passes (unless on a ramp base tile).
No other sheep already occupies the same base tile.

facing.rule: Horizontal sprite flip follows movement direction. When |dx| > 0.01 during a committed move step, facing = 1 (right) if dx > 0, else -1 (left).

placementVsMovement.placement: Initial scatter (placementRules.onLandOnly) never spawns sheep on water, cliff-face cells, cliff-base cells, or ramp cells.
placementVsMovement.movement: During roaming, ramp cells are the only legal way to change elevation tier. These rules are complementary: spawn avoids ramps; movement uses ramps exclusively for tier changes.

anchor.note: Bottom-centre of the frame meets the ground tile.

footprint.note: Collision/placement occupies one 64x64 tile; sprite artwork extends above the cell.

usage.summary: Sheep idle animation. Loop all 6 frames at 10 fps.
usage.note: One of three sheep behaviour states from Sheep.aseprite. Example map scatters idle and grass only.

onLandOnly.rule: Place only on land cells (elevation >= 0). Never on water, cliff-face cells, cliff-base cells, or stair/ramp cells.
onLandOnly.appliesTo: Walkable grass at any elevation tier.
onLandOnly.doNotApply: Water (elevation -1), cells below south-facing cliffs, ramp landing/top cells.

preferInteriorGrass.rule: Prefer fully-surrounded centre grass (autotile piece 5, mask 1111) for consistent scatter with other props.
